title: AI System Audit Procedures and Checklists
content:
Comprehensive AI audit procedures ensure ongoing compliance and performance:

**Pre-Deployment Audit:**
- Training data documentation complete
- Model card created and reviewed
- Bias testing across protected categories
- Security vulnerability assessment
- Privacy impact assessment
- Performance benchmarks established
- Rollback procedures documented
- Monitoring dashboards configured

**Quarterly Operational Audit:**
- Performance metrics vs. baseline
- Drift analysis (data and concept)
- User feedback analysis
- Incident review and lessons learned
- Access control verification
- Data retention compliance
- Model version inventory

**Annual Comprehensive Audit:**
- Full bias and fairness assessment
- Third-party security penetration testing
- Regulatory compliance review
- Stakeholder interview process
- Competitive benchmark analysis
- Technology refresh assessment
- Training program effectiveness review

**Audit Reporting Requirements:**
All audits must produce standardized reports including executive summary, findings, risk ratings, remediation recommendations, and timeline for corrective actions.
